categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and touches Guix toolchain definitions and depends build scripts under contrib/guix and depends/.
categories.rationale: Reduces non-GUI release binary sizes by roughly 0.5 MB by disabling unused wide-character formatting and zoneinfo routines in libstdc++. While beneficial for binary trimming, it is a modest optimization that does not affect build reproducibility, integrity, or supported platform breakage.
